goal: Concurrent first-time opens of both postgres stores against a fresh schema all succeed with the database's server-side deadlock counter unchanged.

graders.name: behavior
graders.run: bash -c 's=$(uv run pytest packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_postgres_bootstrap_concurrency.py -q 2>&1); r=$?; echo "$s"; [ "$r" -eq 0 ] || exit 1; echo "$s" | grep -qi skipped && exit 1; echo "$s" | grep -q " passed"'

graders.name: lint
graders.run: uv run ruff check packages/flywheel-core packages/flywheel-orchestrator

relevant: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/store_postgres.py -- PostgresStore._bootstrap runs unserialized DDL on every open; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_claims_postgres.py -- PostgresClaimStore._bootstrap, same unserialized shape; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
conftest.py -- the session-scoped postgres testcontainer fixtures (postgres_dsn, require_postgres) the new test builds on
references: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_claims_postgres.py -- acquire_claim already serializes via pg_advisory_xact_lock; bootstrap needs the same discipline
constraints: Safety lives inside the stores: any set of concurrent openers is safe without out-of-band provisioning, on both PostgresStore and PostgresClaimStore
The new test asserts the server-side deadlock counter (pg_stat_database.deadlocks delta == 0) across at least 8 concurrent fresh-schema opens per store kind, plus zero raised exceptions
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not change any table shape, query, or claim/lease semantics
Do not route any new caller onto the postgres stores -- wiring is a separate task
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: Catch-and-retry masking must fail: the server-side deadlock counter increments even when the client swallows DeadlockDetected and retries, so only genuine serialization passes
Re-opening an already-provisioned schema stays idempotent and does not error while another instance holds the bootstrap lock
